verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents out-of-office handling, including telling Reclaim you're on vacation while optionally still scheduling Tasks and Habits. It also supports ad-hoc availability overrides through hashtags (#reclaim_free for no-meeting days, #reclaim_busy to reserve time), and scheduling links share your availability. However, nothing in the pack shows defining working-hours schedules or a structured date-override feature, so the overrides depend on calendar-event hashtags. Missing for 10: documented working-hours or availability-schedule configuration, a dedicated date-override UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the OOO and override behavior.
